points.evidence: Original exceptional control conversions skip normal free16; concrete exact-original body fixture demonstrates unreleased heap buffers. Remaining APIs use WINAPI and CB_DIR uses WOW_TEXT_ACTIVE/MAPPED constants declared in this header; do not replace with implicit declarations.

Exact pinned original converter body leaks the acquired buffer when construction, callback or copyback escapes before normal free16. Existing per-call dwTmp[1] records only completed malloc16. lParam alone is not a safe ownership marker: it initially contains a native pointer, and LB_DIR assigns the acquired local vp only after putstr16. A generic lParam-only finalizer would need converter-specific construction tracking; moving that table into a shim does not simplify the complete solution. Remove redundant standalone comment; retain one wrapper pending owner decision.

Normal original free16 does not clear the captured ownership key. The existing finalizer must also clean exceptional exits, so restoring only this free would leave a stale key and cause a second release. The current helper consumes the key before invoking original free16; normal output copy order remains unchanged. Retain minimal single-call substitution pending owner decision.

Keep the single local snapshot while clearing dwParam before DeleteParamMap/free16. Initialize at function entry instead of separate unthunk assignment. No extra state owner or failure path.

Restore original absence of these two resets. W32Win16WndProcEx, W32DialogFunc, ThunkCallWndProcHook, ThunkMsgFilterHook and WCD32CommonDialogProc initialize fresh WM32MSGPARAMEX to zero. putmsg16 selects only COMMAND/DDE/DROPFILES and cannot dispatch CB_DIR. Null input already carries null lParam; successful map/heap acquisition assigns lParam; pre-acquisition failure has no ACTIVE bit so unthunk does not free an incoming native pointer.

Original GetParam16 increments map reference count. A callback exception skips normal DeleteParamMap. Captured MAPPED/ACTIVE provenance enables exactly one reference release and prevents treating borrowed guest storage as heap ownership.
CB_DIR fallback malloc16 succeeds before putstr16, which can fault. ACTIVE records the actual acquired allocation without classifying an incoming native pointer as guest ownership.

Original unthunk does not record consumed ownership. Calling it on normal exit and final cleanup decrements the borrowed reference twice, or frees heap twice. Retain consumed-state release using original DeleteParamMap/free16; remove only duplicate local assignment. Original map count and heap release fixtures cover normal/abort/repeated cleanup.

Without ACTIVE, pre-acquisition fault cleanup could use the incoming native lParam, or repeated cleanup could release already consumed storage. Gate release on acquired state, not pointer nonzeroness.
